heading: OTDR
bottomHtml: An OTDR (Optical Time Domain Reflectometer) is an essential testing device for the Bangladeshi ISP industry, ensuring fiber optic networks deliver the highest performance. It detects cable faults, measures splice loss, and verifies link quality with pinpoint accuracy. For ISPs running GPON, EPON, or FTTH projects, OTDR reduces troubleshooting time, minimizes downtime, and helps maintain customer satisfaction with uninterrupted high-speed internet.
